system.description:
Your Flail strikes the enemy directly where their heart would be attempting to disrupt its rhythm. Make a melee Taijutsu attack against a creature within range, On hit, the creature takes [Weapons damage] +7d10, additionally, the target must make a Constitution Saving throw. On a failure, the creature gains 3 ranks of Weakened and also becomes Staggered.

Chain 3: A creature that fails their saving throw by 5 or more is Stunned until the end of their next turn. A creature that fails their saving throw by 10 or more is knocked unconscious for the next minute.
